actions.test: Runs gates as a check on the dive on deck, or the gates named, streaming each and exiting 1 if any gate that is not flaky failed
actions.hydrate-repo.workspace: Checks one registered repo out into the workspace, detached at trunk or at a ref
actions.dehydrate-repo.workspace: Removes one repo's checkout from the workspace once origin has its work, or regardless with --force
actions.record.gate: Mints a gate: its doc, its stub script, and the link declaring it on a feat, ready to fail until somebody writes the check
actions.note: Mints one kb doc and links it from the repo it is about
actions.jump: Picks a dive up, or starts one on a feat: checks its repos out for it, on its local branch or read-only at trunk
actions.pack: Puts the dive on deck down for anyone, on any hero repo, to jump again: its work pushed to its refs, its ignored files packed for its feat, its checkouts left at their base
actions.bail: Abandons the dive on deck, recording why and what it held
actions.land: Publishes the dive on deck: each repo's work pushed to its feat's work branch

dive.dropWhen: It was jumped and is over, its link `landed.dive` or `bailed.dive`; and what its log learned is kept where it lasts: each decision made and each lesson worth keeping recorded on the durable doc it concerns, the feature or area its feat works toward, never only in the dive, whose log goes with it. A bailed dive's reason is such a lesson when the next attempt needs it, as a slice found too big to review. One held or packed is not dropped: jump it and finish it. Whoever drops it, having read it, records what it completed on the doc that links it, `nosedive crud <linking doc> --section:Dropped.<dive> -`, then `nosedive crud --drop <dive>`, which takes the state link with it, as `meta.next` declares it (drop-takes-declared-links).
